steps.title: Why did it break?
steps.body: Type `enable`. Run `show clock` and `show crypto pki certificates`. What is wrong with the gateway's certificate? `submit PROBLEM=...` (expired, revoked or wrong-name). Who issued it? `submit ISSUER=...`.

steps.title: Renew it
steps.body: In `conf t`: `crypto pki trustpoint SKYPORT-TP`, then `enrollment url http://10.0.0.20:80`, `subject-name CN=vpn.skyport.grid`, `revocation-check ocsp`, `exit`. Then `crypto pki enroll SKYPORT-TP`. `end` and check `show crypto pki certificates` again.

objectives.label: Enrollment URL points at the Grid CA
New certificate granted by the CA

steps.title: Refuse the forgery
steps.body: Read `more flash:connect-log.txt`. Should the gateway trust the laptop that presented a certificate from DOOM-CA? `submit TRUST=yes` or `no`. And which port does the crew's TLS VPN use? `submit PORT=...`.
